theorem lg_target {α : Type u} {β : Type v} (f : Set (α → β)) (s : Set α) [Finite ↑f] [Finite ↑s] : Finite ↑(f.seq s) := by
  have : Finite ↑(⋃ g ∈ ↑f, s → g) :=
    Finite.union (↑f.Finite) (λ g hg,
      let g_set := ↑g,
      have : Finite ↑(s → g_set) :=
        Finite.Set.finite_image s (fun x => x) [Finite ↑s],
      exact this)
  exact this
